topics.label: Joule AI Assistant
topics.prompt: Search for recent reviews, opinions, and feedback from SAP customers, engineers, and implementation partners about SAP Joule AI assistant. Find LinkedIn posts, SAP community forums, Reddit discussions, and tech blogs. What do real users think? What are the main complaints, praise, and concerns? Critically evaluate whether Joule is genuinely useful or marketing-driven. Look for specific cases where it helped or failed. Include exact quotes or near-verbatim paraphrases with full attribution (name, role, platform, date).
queries: Joule AI assistant SAP community feedback

topics.label: BTP & AI Agents
topics.prompt: Search for technical opinions and reviews about SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) AI capabilities and SAP AI agents (Joule agents). What do SAP architects, BTP developers, and consultants say in their blog posts, community forums, and conference talks? Is the AI agent framework production-ready? What are the real integration challenges? Include exact quotes from named practitioners with source attribution.

topics.label: Partner Opinions
topics.prompt: Search for what Accenture, Capgemini, Deloitte, IBM, and other SAP implementation partners publicly say about SAP's AI strategy, Joule, and SAP Business AI. Find their blog posts, press releases, and consultant opinions on LinkedIn. What do senior partners and practice leads really think off-script? Where do they privately hedge against SAP AI maturity? Include direct quotes with attribution from specific individuals.

topics.label: vs. Competitors
topics.prompt: Search for comparisons between SAP AI capabilities and competitors: Salesforce Einstein AI, Oracle AI, Microsoft Dynamics AI, Workday AI. What do analysts, customers, and tech journalists say in head-to-head assessments? Who is winning in enterprise AI? Where does SAP specifically lag or lead with quantified evidence? Include exact analyst quotes and named customer testimonials with attribution.
queries: SAP AI vs Microsoft Copilot ERP

topics.label: Business Data Cloud
topics.prompt: Search for opinions and feedback about SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) and the Databricks partnership. What do data engineers, data architects, and CDOs say about the semantic layer, data products approach, and real-world integration challenges? Is BDC addressing the core SAP data fragmentation problem? Include verbatim quotes from practitioners with full source attribution.

topics.label: Customer Satisfaction
topics.prompt: Search for SAP customer satisfaction data: Gartner Peer Insights reviews, G2 reviews, TrustRadius ratings, NPS surveys, and analyst reports specifically about SAP AI products. What are the quantified satisfaction scores? What pain points appear most frequently across multiple reviews? Include specific verbatim review excerpts and named analyst quotes with source and date.
queries: SAP AI Gartner Peer Insights review

topics.label: S/4HANA AI Features
topics.prompt: Search for user experiences and technical opinions about AI features embedded in SAP S/4HANA. What do finance, supply chain, and HR professionals say about actual day-to-day usage? What is the gap between AI features promised at TechEd vs. what is GA and usable? Include exact quotes from practitioners — named SAP Community users, LinkedIn posts, conference panelists — with attribution.
queries: RISE with SAP AI migration feedback

topics.label: Risks & Gaps
topics.prompt: Search for analyst criticism, investor concerns, and technical blog posts that highlight gaps or risks in SAP's AI strategy. Is SAP's AI foundational or superficial layering on old architecture? Are they structurally behind on generative AI? What do former SAP employees, critical analysts, and competitor advocates say? Include exact critical quotes with source attribution to show the bear case clearly.

topics.label: SAP RPT1
topics.prompt: Search for practitioner feedback, technical reviews, and real-world experiences with SAP RPT1 (Role Prompt Templates) - the AI-powered assistant framework for SAP Business AI. Find opinions from SAP developers, implementation consultants, and enterprise users about RPT1's usefulness, maturity, and integration capabilities. What do users say about actual deployment success? What are the common challenges, benefits, and gaps compared to expectations? Include exact quotes from named practitioners with full source attribution (name, role, company/platform, date). Focus heavily on 2026 and late 2025 sources to ensure recency and relevance.
